title: Take It Easy Vacation Rental
meta_description: Take-It-Easy is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionTake It EasyGulf Place Retreat | Louva Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights:4 Bedrooms (see room configurations under “Room Details” tab)4.5 Bathrooms2,760 Sq FtPrivate backyard with plunge pool, daybed swing, trellis-wrapped Jasmine (pool not heated)1st Floor: King Master Suite with ensuite, walk-in shower, dual sinks, half bath, open-concept kitchen, living & dining area2nd Floor: King Guest Master Suite with ensuite, Queen Guest Suite & King Guest Suite with ensuite bathroomsFour-vehicle drivewayAll new furnishingsOutdoor gas grillFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not included; rentals available upon request)The SpaceTake It Easy is exactly what its name suggests—a serene retreat designed for effortless relaxation. The bright, open living area features stacking sliding doors that create seamless indoor/outdoor living, opening to a private backyard oasis. Enjoy the plunge pool, daybed swing, trellis-wrapped Jasmine, string lights, and patio seating. The outdoor grill and dining area accommodate family and friends with seating for eight at the table and four at the kitchen island.The gourmet kitchen boasts wood-stained cabinets, leathered granite countertops, subway tile backsplash, dual-ice maker refrigerator, and gas range with drawer microwave. The first-floor King Master Suite features double sinks and a walk-in shower, with a half bath also located on this level. Upstairs, three guest bedrooms each have private baths, and a loft area provides additional space for relaxing. Step outside to easily access the community basketball court or use the enclosed outdoor shower after a day at the beach. Gulf Place—with popular local restaurants like Shunk Gulley and Perfect Pig—is just down the road.Beach AccessEd Walline Regional Beach Access is only 0.3 miles away—a 5–7 minute walk or 1–2 minute bike ride. This public access at the end of Hwy 393 features parking, restrooms, outdoor showers, and on-site beach chair rentals.Golf CartsOne golf cart rental is allowed per home, making it easy to explore 30A and visit area restaurants and the beach.Pool HeatingPool heating is available November–April, but cannot operate effectively if outdoor temperatures drop below 50°F.ParkingDriveway accommodates up to four vehicles.PoliciesNo smokingPets not allowed (service animals permitted with advance notice and documentation)Published rates do not include tax and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior to arrivalCancellations more than 60 days prior: initial 50% fully refundable minus 5% processing feeOptional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTTenant must be at least 25 years old and present during the rental period
